caption: The drawing depicts a woven design featuring a building and a tree. The building is positioned in the center, stretching nearly the full width of the rectangular composition. The left half of the building—colored in red—has a central door with arched windows on both sides and a prominent triangular roof with a cupola. The right half of the building is blue, with two rows of rectangular windows. Adjacent to the right side of the building is a white tree with a tall trunk and branches spreading outward, set against the blue background. The woven pattern is made up of interlacing red, blue, and white threads, forming a dense textile texture, while at the bottom, loose threads in red, white, and blue dangle freely, giving the appearance of fringes. The background is divided into a red section on the left and a blue section on the right, corresponding to the colors of the building. The entire composition rests on an off-white surface.
title: Coverlet Detail "Farmer's Fancy"
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
